query.description: Polyglot scan ID to filter to; defaults to the latest scan.

The code branch at scan time. Ignored if polygot_scan or scan_version are given.

The analysis platform. Cannot be specified together with scan_language.
The analysis language. Cannot be specified together with scan_platform.

The tags to exclude from 'counts' in the response. Can be specified more than once. The default filters out a small set of tags that don't add too much value in the kind of aggregate that 'counts' contains. An empty value resets the list.
Only list findings of the given type. Can be specified multiple times.

Only list findings containing the given value (under simple Unicode case-folding) in their title or description. Can be specified up to 5 times.  A finding will match a series of searches if it matches all of them.
Only list reachable findings.
Only list exploitable findings.
Only list findings with an AI fix available.

The field used to sort results.

The Qwiet API allows you to programmatically interact with Qwiet. You can manage users and their roles and get scan-related information, such as which applications were scanned and what vulnerabilities were identified by Qwiet as being present. You can also compare scans to see changes to your applications over time.

# Authentication

Use of the Qwiet API requires an access token, which is available via the [Qwiet UI](https://app.shiftleft.io/user/profile).
